at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:02466e GetStage

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local input=require('openmw.input')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local frame=0
local sampleFrame=nil
local held=false
local lastDead=-1
local centerline=false
local function aim(p)
 local v=camera.getViewTransform():apply(p)
 local yaw=math.atan2(v.x,-v.z)
 local pitch=-math.atan2(v.y,math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.z*v.z))
 local function units(a) return math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(a*5120+.5))) end
 local gain=camera.getMode()==camera.MODE.FirstPerson and 1 or 2
 return units(yaw*gain),units(pitch)
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frame=frame+1
 local down=input.isKeyPressed(input.KEY.F7)
 if down and not held then sampleFrame=frame+3 end
 if not down then sampleFrame=nil end
 held=down
 if sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Early camera settled') end
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self) and Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died during wall encounter')
 if frame==5 then print('Joined wall encounter ready') end
 if Actor.getStance(self)==Actor.STANCE.Weapon then print('Joined wall fists ready') end
 if self.position.y>=3190 then print('Joined wall centerline reached') end
 local target,distance,dead=nil,nil,0
 for _,id in ipairs({{0x37e40,0x37e41,0x37e42}}) do
  local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id))
  if a and a:isValid() then
   if Actor.isDead(a) then dead=dead+1 elseif a.enabled then
    assert(a.position.z > -1200,'Required live wall rat below tutorial floor: '..tostring(id)..' '..tostring(a.position))
    local d=(a.position-self.position):length()
    if not distance or d<distance then target,distance=a,d end
   end
  end
 end
 if dead~=lastDead then lastDead=dead print('Joined early rat dead count '..dead) end
 if distance and distance<=130 then print('Joined wall rat in reach') end
 if self.position.x>=275 or (distance and distance<=130) then print('Joined wall first approach reached') end
 local x,y=aim(util.vector3(560,3190,-780))
 print(string.format('Joined wall crossing aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
 if math.abs(x)<120 and math.abs(y)<120 then print('Joined wall crossing facing') end
 if target then
  local rx,ry=aim(target.position+util.vector3(0,0,35))
  print(string.format('Joined wall rat aim x=%d y=%d distance=%.2f',rx,ry,distance))
  if math.abs(rx)<120 and math.abs(ry)<120 and sampleFrame and frame>=sampleFrame then print('Joined wall rat facing') end
 end
 if self.position.y>=3190 then centerline=true end
 local routeGoal=centerline and util.vector3(285,3190,self.position.z+100) or util.vector3(40,3220,self.position.z+100)
 local facingGoal=distance and distance<=180 and target.position+util.vector3(0,0,35) or routeGoal
 local mx,my=aim(facingGoal)
 print(string.format('Joined wall combat route aim x=%d y=%d',mx,my))
 if centerline and self.position.x>=275 and dead>=1 then print('Joined wall combat approach complete') end
 if self.position.x>=560 then print('Joined wall crossed') end
 if frame%15==0 then print('Joined wall player '..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' fatigue='..Actor.stats.dynamic.fatigue(self).current) end
end}}}}
